messages:
Ellen (Finance): FYI vendor 'CloudSentry' sent invoice INV-2026-801 with no PO on the PDF. Due 2026-04-02. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-801.pdf Can procurement confirm PO and approver?
Oscar (AP): AP blocked payment because invoice has no PO and the amount $12,300 doesn't match any single PO. Invoice Bot returned: 'no match'.
Invoice Bot: No matching PO found for vendor CloudSentry / INV-2026-801. Suggested actions: attach PO in metadata or verify split across multiple POs.
Maya (Procurement): SearchingFound two related POs: PO-4992-SW $7,500 and PO-4993-SVC $4,800. Vendor seems to have consolidated.
Victor (Eng Ops): PO-4993-SVC is for my team (edge infra). I approved estimate but didn't expect vendor to merge invoices. I can approve the invoice for the service portion if Proc tags the split.
Ellen (Finance): We need both POs linked for AP to pay. If vendor will not reissue, Procurement can map POs in the AP system manually. Also confirm currency (invoice is USD).
Maya (Procurement): I'll add both PO refs to invoice metadata and note allocation: 4992 -> 6100, 4993 -> 6202. Routing: PO-4992 approver is Maya; PO-4993 approver is Victor.
Invoice Bot: PO-4992 and PO-4993 attached. Routing to Maya and Victor for approval.
Victor (Eng Ops): Approved PO-4993-SVC. 
Maya (Procurement): Approved PO-4992-SW. AP: please proceed.
Oscar (AP): Marked INV-2026-801 ready for payment. Scheduled for 2026-04-01 batch to avoid due-date slip. Added ledger notes about PO split and vendor consolidation.
Ellen (Finance): Closing loop. Finance will record allocation per PO GLs. Leave vendor note to avoid consolidated invoices in future.
notes: vendor consolidated two POs; procurement attached both POs in metadata; approvers signed off; payment scheduled.
